queries: SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS diff_from_overall FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY diff_from_overall IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

WITH e AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM e) AS diff_from_overall FROM e ORDER BY diff_from_overall IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average remaining is the average of `remaining` across all budget lines (non-null values), not the average of the per-event averages.
Budget lines with a NULL link_to_event are excluded because they belong to no event. Ties at the cutoff are broken arbitrarily.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of the per-event average remaining values, so each event is weighted equally.

Budget lines with no `link_to_event` are not an event, so they are left out of the per-event rows. They are still counted in the overall average.
Ties in the difference have no specified order.
